component.name: hwcloud-iam
component.title: Huawei Identity and Access Management (IAM)
component.description: List, read and update the users and user groups of Huawei Cloud Identity and Access Management (IAM).
component.label: cloud

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

producerIn.description: Not used by the list and get operations, which take the ids from the options or the CamelHwCloudIamUserId and CamelHwCloudIamGroupId exchange properties. updateUser needs an UpdateUserOption of the Huawei Cloud SDK or its JSON, and updateGroup a KeystoneUpdateGroupOption or its JSON, as text, bytes, a stream or a file: another body fails

producerOut.description: The JSON of the result as text: the array of the users or the groups for listUsers, listGroups and getGroupUsers, the user or the group for getUser, updateUser and updateGroup. The keys are the field names of the IAM API, such as domain_id, as in the JSON of the request

operation.label: producer
operation.description: The operation that the producer performs: listUsers, getUser, updateUser, listGroups, getGroupUsers or updateGroup. The CamelHwCloudIamOperation exchange property replaces this option.

accessKey.description: The access key ID (AK) of the Huawei Cloud credentials. Not used when the serviceKeys option is set.

groupId.description: The ID of the user group for getGroupUsers and updateGroup, which fail without it. The CamelHwCloudIamGroupId exchange property replaces this option.

proxyHost.description: The host name or IP address of the proxy server. The producer uses a proxy only when this option and the proxyPort option are set.

proxyPassword.description: The password to authenticate with the proxy server. It is used only when the proxyHost, proxyPort and proxyUser options are set.

proxyPort.description: The port of the proxy server. The producer uses a proxy only when this option is above 0 and the proxyHost option is set.

proxyUser.description: The user name to authenticate with the proxy server. It is used only when the proxyHost and proxyPort options are set.

region.description: The region ID of IAM, for example cn-north-4. The producer uses it to find the endpoint of IAM, and fails to start the client when the Huawei Cloud SDK does not know the region for IAM.

secretKey.description: The secret access key (SK) of the Huawei Cloud credentials. Not used when the serviceKeys option is set.

serviceKeys.description: The AK/SK pair as an org.apache.camel.component.huaweicloud.common.models.ServiceKeys. When set, its accessKey and its secretKey replace the accessKey and secretKey options.

userId.description: The ID of the IAM user for getUser and updateUser, which fail without it. The CamelHwCloudIamUserId exchange property replaces this option.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer,advanced
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

ignoreSslVerification.label: security
ignoreSslVerification.description: Whether to skip the verification of the TLS certificate of the server. This makes the connection insecure: use it only for testing.
